name: shipwatch
description: Dashboard pane for every repo under a GitHub owner: running builds, open PRs and a per-repo stepper from PR to release.

owner.title: GitHub owner
owner.description: User or org whose repos to watch. Empty means the account `gh` is signed in as.

pollSeconds.title: Idle poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to refresh while nothing is building. While a build runs it refreshes every 20 seconds.

maxRepos.title: Max repos
maxRepos.description: Most recently pushed repos to track (1-100).

staleDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleDays.description: A repo with no push or PR activity for this long, and nothing building, moves to the collapsed Stale group.

ignoreRepos.title: Ignore repos
ignoreRepos.description: Comma-separated repo names to leave out.

githubToken.title: GitHub token (fallback)
githubToken.description: Only used when the `gh` CLI cannot be run from here. A token with repo read access.

autoFix.title: Auto-fix broken main builds
autoFix.description: When a default-branch build goes from running to failing, queue a prompt in this session asking Claude to find the cause and open a fix PR. Runs only while a session is open and idle.

autoFixLimit.title: Auto-fix limit per session
autoFixLimit.description: Most fix prompts to queue in one session, so a failure that can't be fixed doesn't loop.
